name: Binance (proof-of-reserves page, manual download only)
tier_rationale: Established exchange operator with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2). V3LUM never contacts this host: the page answers scripts with a bot interstitial, so the analyst downloads the address list in a browser and imports it with provenance (P358 cond 2).

reliability.justification: Exchange-published reserve address lists (ownership claimed by the exchange, no per-address signature); snapshots are dated.

proof_of_reserves.title: Binance proof-of-reserves wallet address list - manual download by the analyst

terms.reviewer: batch p2-G09-3 (research C0788: 'Exchange website terms (manual download for internal labelling)'; not reviewed by legal)

proof_of_reserves.notes: Never fetched by V3LUM: research 2026-11-25 saw HTTP 202 with an empty body from CloudFront (bot interstitial) for scripts - never automated past it (team rule 1, A9). P358 cond 2: the analyst imports the downloaded list with exchange, PoR date and source URL; unsigned PoR rows are PROBABLE and lose one confidence step after 12 months. Not declared by any module as a registry source: imported files are analyst-provided local data; legal to confirm internal-labelling use of the exchange terms.
